audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-6].side (full layer) all read 'Skill' — a placeholder that agrees with neither champion — while content win[0-6] reads Lux x6 then Renata at 2+ items.
audit.why: The content layer's whys[] already tell a grounded story matching the kit: Lux outranges Renata pre-6 (no early poke, short E tether), holds through 6 since her R is teamfight-only in a 2v2, but Renata's R/E-root/Bailout package flips fights alone at 2+ items. The full layer's side/why fields were never filled in.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[].side to match win[N], and rewrote each phases[].why to state the same reason as the paired content whys[N].

audit.why: Spikes (Lvl 2 outrange, Lvl 6 R irrelevant to a 2v2, first item burst before scaling, late R/E/Bailout flip) are already stated with grounded reasoning.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.spikes[0].text names Renata's E as 'Loyal Bodyguard' — the kit's real name for that slot is 'Loyalty Program'. Also both missingInteractions entries (E shield absorbs burst, W sustain needs anti-heal timing) were missing from the page, and report[8]/report[9] misgendered Renata as 'his'/'His'.
audit.why: The wrong ability name is a direct factual error; the shield/sustain facts change all-in sequencing and itemization and were missing in favor of a duplicated tradeGood/tradeBad line.
audit.corrected: Fixed the ability name in content.spikes[0].text, added the shield-bait fact to dosFull[0].d and the Bailout-revive/anti-heal fact to dontsFull[2].d, added real cooldowns to breakdown.cooldowns, and fixed the two misgendered report lines.
